eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Siskiyou, CA; at 5:08 PM on AUG 26, 2025 Effective until 1:08 AM AUG 27, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Siskiyou County Sheriffs Office has issued an EVACUATION ORDER for Zones 1506, 1402A, 1503A, 1509B in the area of Ti-Bar Rd due to Dillon Fire. Anyone in this area is ordered to leave now. GET OUT NOW!
